both.statement: Damage from a machine part card always hits the player's shields first, if any shields remain.
both.quotedFromA: Damage dealt by a machine part card is always applied to the player's shields first, provided the player still has shields remaining.
both.quotedFromB: When damage is taken, shields absorb that damage first if any shields remain.

both.statement: Taking damage reduces shield dice value first, until expended.
both.quotedFromA: Taking damage reduces the value of the player's shield dice first, continuing until those dice are completely expended.
both.quotedFromB: Shield dice value is reduced as damage is taken.

both.statement: Fully expended shield dice are removed to the spent dice pile.
both.quotedFromA: Shield dice that have been completely expended are removed and placed in the player's spent dice pile.
both.quotedFromB: When shield dice are completely expended, they are removed to the spent dice pile.

both.statement: Damage not absorbed by shields carries over as direct HP damage.
both.quotedFromA: Damage left over after the shield dice have absorbed what they can carries over and is applied directly to the player's HP.
both.quotedFromB: Damage not absorbed by shield dice carries over and deals direct damage to HP.

both.statement: Winning requires destroying the Doom Core.
both.quotedFromA: The win condition is the destruction of the Doom Core.
both.quotedFromB: The game is won when the Doom Core is destroyed.

both.statement: Clearing all machine part cards is not required to win.
both.quotedFromA: Clearing every machine part card is not required in order to win.
both.quotedFromB: Clearing all machine part cards is not required to win the game.

both.statement: A player whose HP reaches zero loses the game.
both.quotedFromA: If the player's HP drops to zero, the player is destroyed by the machine and loses the game.
both.quotedFromB: If a player's HP is reduced to zero, that player loses the game.

bOnly.statement: Machine part cards deal damage to the player.
bOnly.sourceSentence: Any time a machine part card deals you damage, it will always damage your shields first (if you have any remaining).
